items.title: Is L3Harris Technologies (LHX) A Bargain Following Its US$121 Million Army Radio Orders?
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) just landed fresh U.S. Army production orders worth US$121 million for its Low Cost Data Radio, tying the stock story more closely to command and control communications spending. Recent trading has been choppy for L3Harris Technologies, with the share price down 6.46% on the day, even after a 9.65% gain over the past month.
